headline: Executive order creates a board to advise the President on economic recovery.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new group called the President's Economic Recovery Advisory Board. Based on its title, the board's job is to give the President advice about helping the economy recover. No summary was provided, so details such as who serves on the board, how long it lasts, and what it can do are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: The President and White House economic staff
who_it_affects.how: They gain a formal advisory board that gives them advice on economic recovery.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 6, 2009. Executive orders usually take effect when signed.
